findings.status: implemented; targeted tests and independent official-source replay passed; final release integration owned by root task
findings.observed: CommonHudConfig has four independent service entry names: YearPay, ArenaService, QualifyingCompetitionService and TaskPanelService. Existing build_discovery only retained NewActivityService calls.
findings.additionalGap: The current YearPay adapter has four external tab entries, yearpay26tab2/3/4/5. tab5 was not included in the earlier audit inventory. The same SWF retains the historical 2025 adapter; importing every string would introduce historical tabs incorrectly.
findings.requiredFix: Resolve official service registration, evaluate supported date-enum adapter selection, then follow reachable current class references and explicit tab consumers. Unknown selector shape must produce a pending coverage record, never a whole-history fallback. Cache must include selector date/epoch.

findings.status: implemented; targeted tests and independent official-source replay passed; final release integration owned by root task
findings.observed: No service-root discovery accounting exists, so zero pending can coexist with an unvisited current service and all its tabs. Current ArenaService and QualifyingCompetitionService also call storeexchangeframework explicitly; these are references to an already separately parsed shop and must not double count goods.
findings.additionalEvidence: TaskPanelService -> Tpv2Controller -> Tpv2Util.callNewAct(maintaskguider) uses a verified wrapper forwarding its first parameter into loadAndInitNormalActivity. ArenaV3Controller also binds a literal alias into a local variable before invoking the same loader. Both patterns require explicit call binding rather than a service-name allowlist.
findings.requiredFix: Persist service-entry/registered/scanned/reachable/inactive/unresolved counts and per-entry source evidence; add unresolved real entry links to pending; preserve deliberate exclusion of already handled common shop.

findings.status: implemented; service body replay has exactly one current preorder reward and no historical inventory products
findings.observed: Current YearPay Tab1 has a preorder reward implemented inside the service rather than an external activity tab. It uses effect 35$71:1 and race constant 6984 in a real showStrengthenPanel call.
findings.payment: StrengthenComboPaymentFactory.getSimple(doPay) invokes the supplied callback; doPay calls takePreOrderPrize -> CMD_GAIN_RED (88_2026_7) with AQSOutDetails.params. It is a gated reward claim, not a diamond purchase.
findings.requiredFix: Pass only the current service class graph into the existing generic reward parser; resolve bound local variables and exact claim prerequisites using the real consumer.

findings.status: implemented; all three persistent registry containers are candidates, current routes only become roots
findings.observed: The official activity XML has an activity branch of permanent registrations as well as release-week branches. Existing discovery only registered week/a entries. Current HUD aoqihoservey and livestreampromotion and service-linked maintaskguider are registered in activity/a, so they appeared falsely missing.
findings.requiredFix: Load permanent registrations as candidate mappings and follow only current HUD/real call links; do not indiscriminately root all permanent/history rows.

limitations: Static class reachability is an over-approximation within the selected current adapter; it is not a live account run.

behaviors: Uses actual ServiceConfig helper-to-ServiceInfo argument mappings, no service-name/resource mapping allowlist.
Traces only local classes referenced by the selected current date adapter; historical/future adapters stay outside the graph.
Verifies YearPayRange-like newest-begun enum selection and DateUtil server closing time, caches only until the next known selection/tab boundary.
Finds consumed static tab arrays/IIFE arrays, literal activity calls, verified parameter-forwarding wrappers and stable local literal bindings.
Persists every entry resolution and all service scans; active root/tab linkage errors are pending, missing optional references remain explicitly recorded in coverage.
Handles registered but unversioned resources with the official loader default and dependency-bound invalidation.
On service discovery failure preserves only the previous confirmed roots and marks exclusively dependent goods stale/price unknown, then reparses after recovery.

newcomerRuleEvidence.impact: Discovered beginner rewards expose 25$6, 37$6 and 53$5. The existing native rule compiler has no components for these actual reward types and returns Unknown despite available complete pet details.

25.consumer: StrengthenComboFlowEquipmentSingle; EquipmentNewStrategy_Params.defaultFilter requires GodJob and not ShenYun; Equipment4Pet.createFromString uses eps slot id|exp|level|...
25.preservation: Retain an equipped exclusive source beast; the official common selection includes the current exclusive and only allows that selection. A higher target level can still upgrade it.

37.parameters: Current FlowStargodSingle does not read them; strategy offers gold, default level 6, ordinary slots only
37.preservation: Use existing owned/backpack and job-compatible star facts. Do not suggest replacing already sufficient red stars with gold.

53.consumer: StrengthenComboFlowStoneSingle; LegendStoneStrategy_Params.defaultFilter requires Legend and not ShenYun; PetLegendStoneSlot parses lss id:state:level:exp and defaults an omitted level to 5

35.parameters: The complete first parameter is the star ID; numeric trailing parameters are preserved but not interpreted as another star, a quantity or a level
35.consumer: FlowStargodSingle, OuterStargodSingle and WindowSItem all read parameter index 0 only
